subject: How to use downloadHandler to download data based on the active tab.

messages.author: 118587cb69bd8335
messages.subject: How to use downloadHandler to download data based on the active tab.
parts:
Hi, 

I have two tabPanels, each rendered by different dataset on the backend. 
I tried to let downloadHandler download the dataset that is on the active tabPanel. 
I used the following code but it only returns data on the first tabPanel(conv):

    output$downloadData <- downloadHandler(
      filename = function() { paste(trimws(input$campaign_name), '.csv', sep='') },
      if(input$reporttype=='conv'){
        content = function(file) {
          write.csv(conv_data(), file,row.names = F)}
      } else{
        content = function(file) {
          write.csv(delivery_data(), file,row.names = F)}
      }
      
    )

Here reporttype is the id for tabPanelSet.

Could you point me to the right direction?

thanks,
Kai
